quote.text: When you start to lose your temper, remember: There's nothing manly about rage. It's courtesy and kindness that define a human being- and a man. That's who possesses strength and nerves and guts, not the angry whiners.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • When you feel your patience waning with your child, remember that true strength lies not in force or anger, but in gentle guidance and measured strength.
    • Modeling courtesy and kindness teaches your child that emotional control and empathy are the truest marks of maturity, helping them grow into balanced, thoughtful adults.
  • Leadership
    • An effective leader disciplines both their actions and emotions, understanding that losing temper undermines trust and diminishes respect from colleagues and subordinates.
    • Seek to cultivate courtesy and calm under pressure, for these are the qualities that inspire loyalty and make for a leader who can truly navigate the storms of adversity.
  • Product Management
    • In the realm of product management, frustrations and unexpected challenges will arise; keeping a measured, thoughtful approach prevents rash decisions that might derail progress.
    • Embrace a leadership style steeped in courtesy and reflective evaluation, for it is the calm and collected mindset that fosters innovation, team cohesion, and ultimately, success.
